{"sql": "SELECT customer_no, SUM(amount) as total_billed, COUNT(*) as invoice_count
FROM erp_invoices
WHERE issued_on >= '2025-07-01' AND issued_on < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY customer_no
ORDER BY total_billed DESC
LIMIT 10"}

turns.text: {"sql": "SELECT name, terms_days, credit_limit, route, email FROM customers WHERE customer_no = 'CU-0007'"}

turns.text:
{"sql": "
SELECT i.invoice_no, i.issued_on, i.due_on, i.amount, i.status,
       p.paid_on, p.amount as paid_amount,
       julianday(p.paid_on) - julianday(i.due_on) as days_late
FROM erp_invoices i
LEFT JOIN erp_payments p ON p.invoice_no = i.invoice_no
WHERE i.customer_no = 'CU-0007'
ORDER BY i.issued_on DESC
LIMIT 30
"}
turns.name: run_sql

turns.text: {"sql": "SELECT SUM(amount) as open_ar, COUNT(*) as open_invoices, MIN(due_on) as oldest_due, MAX(due_on) as newest_due\nFROM erp_invoices WHERE customer_no = 'CU-0007' AND status = 'open'"}

turns.text: {"sql": "SELECT AVG(julianday(p.paid_on) - julianday(i.due_on)) as avg_days_late, COUNT(*) as n\nFROM erp_invoices i JOIN erp_payments p ON p.invoice_no = i.invoice_no\nWHERE i.customer_no = 'CU-0007'"}
